_comment: Merge ONLY the subagents.agents array entries into your existing ~/.raven/config.json. Do not replace the whole file. Keys match Raven ThirdPartyOpenAISubagentConfig / docs (Agent Integrations): name, kind=openai, enabled, description, baseUrl, model, apiKey. baseUrl points at this Java demo's path-prefixed OpenAI-compatible roots (Raven client appends /chat/completions). Start the app with: mvn spring-boot:run. Fill apiKey locally if your gateway requires one (this demo ignores the key for auth). Never commit secrets. Restart/reload the Raven host after editing so the roster rebuilds.

agents.name: image-agent
agents.description: 图像分析 Agent：根据图片 URL / base64（可选）与文字描述，输出视觉内容、物体、场景与风险要点。

agents.name: text-agent
agents.description: 文字分析 Agent：对输入文本做摘要、关键实体、情感/语气与潜在问题提炼。

agents.name: result-agent
agents.description: 结果分析 Agent：综合上游图像分析与文字分析结论，给出一致性判断、冲突点与最终汇总。
